Title: Prediction of hERG channel blockers with directed message passing neural networks
Description: Predicts blockade of the hERG potassium channel, the off-target most commonly responsible for cardiac safety failures. Shan and colleagues applied a directed message-passing neural network, which propagates information along bonds rather than atoms and so distinguishes the direction a substructure is traversed. Training drew on assembled hERG activity data with actives defined by IC50 thresholds. Published hERG sets mix results from patch-clamp and binding assays run under different conditions, which limits how sharply any threshold can be drawn.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound blocks the hERG potassium channel.
